module: Auxiliary controller that raises or lowers axles (typically a truck's liftable axles) to gain ground clearance. It writes a target position into two `electrics.values` (front and rear) that the jbeam reads. Three modes: auto (raises unless speed is too high, speed is too low, the parking brake is applied or lateral acceleration is too strong), manual (always raised) and off (always lowered).
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `velocityThresholdDisable` (14 m/s, above it the axle comes back down), `velocityThresholdEnable` (0.1 m/s, below it it comes back down), `accelerationThreshold` (3 m/s², on |sensors.gy2|), `frontLoweredPosition`/`rearLoweredPosition` (0), `frontRaisedPosition`/`rearRaisedPosition` (1), `frontAxleLiftElectricsName` ("strut_F_axleLift"), `rearAxleLiftElectricsName` ("strut_R_axleLift").
The mode state is saved under the key `<controller name>Mode` in getState/setState.
After `reset`, the electrics are set back to 0 but the mode is not reinitialized (init is not called again because `reset` exists).
The radial menu is added only once (hasBuiltPie).

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: chooses the raised or lowered position depending on the mode (in auto: smoothed speed, wheel speed, parking brake, lateral acceleration) and writes it to the two axle electrics.

setMode.desc: Changes the mode ("auto", "manual" or "off"). An unknown mode is ignored. Displays a UI message unless silent.

silent.desc: true to not display a message.

toggleMode.desc: Switches to the next mode in the order auto, manual, off, auto.

reset.desc: Resets the two axle electrics values to 0.

init.desc: Reads the jbeam parameters, sets the electrics to 0, switches to auto mode and adds the radial menu entry.

setParameters.desc: Modifies the thresholds and the mode on the fly; only the fields present are applied.

parameters.desc: Optional fields: mode, accelerationThreshold, velocityThresholdDisable, velocityThresholdEnable.

getState.desc: Returns the current mode under the key `<name>Mode`.

setState.desc: Restores the mode from a state table (silently) if the value is valid.
